subject: Mobile Development
title: Health Sensors: Phone as Doctor
description: A fast breakdown of Health Sensors: Phone as Doctor for builders.

hook.text: Researchers are developing phone sensors that can detect diseases from your breath or voice.

buildup.text: Phone cameras can estimate heart rate by detecting subtle skin color changes from blood flow.

discovery.text: AI models can screen for conditions like depression, Parkinson's, and COVID from voice patterns.

twist.text: Health monitoring apps face regulatory hurdles. The FDA must approve anything claiming to diagnose.

climax.text: Phones may become the first point of health screening — before you ever see a doctor.

punchline.text: Your phone might detect illness before you feel it.

quiz.question: How can phones estimate heart rate?
options: By detecting subtle skin color changes via the camera
By measuring finger pressure on screen
